timeline.message:
Introduce OperationPurpose#REPOSITORY_ANALYSIS

Allows to distinguish blob store access for repo analysis from other
snapshot activities.
timeline.author: David Turner

diff.patch:
@@ -16,6 +16,7 @@
  */
 public enum OperationPurpose {
     SNAPSHOT("Snapshot"),
+    REPOSITORY_ANALYSIS("RepositoryAnalysis"),
     CLUSTER_STATE("ClusterState"),
     INDICES("Indices"),
     TRANSLOG("Translog");

timeline.body:
Allows to distinguish blob store access for repo analysis from other
snapshot activities.
Should we also introduce a purpose for health checking (may be this will be done as a separate future change)?

reply.body: Possibly, but this specific change is motivated by #101100.

timeline.body: I intend to use this to fix https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/101100.
